structure.sample_location: element constitutive average; t is its material-midpoint plot coordinate
structure.shell_sampling: Inward endpoint properties averaged before interval strain/stress recovery; endpoint_traces use exact sided properties.
structure.peak_sampling: Interval estimates and both endpoint traces; no extrapolation through load or property jumps.
limitations: Interval local components use the arithmetic endpoint transform average, not the orthonormal physical midpoint display frame.
Interval strain follows the selected averaged stiffness/force law. Averaged shell properties give a constitutive interval estimate, not a point sample or an average of endpoint stress.
Endpoint strains use one-sided section properties and conservative endpoint resultants. Both sides of load/property jumps remain distinct.
Shell coordinates are measured from the tension axis per steady Eq.28. Exact historical ASWING output sampling remains unverified.

Closed-shell torsional shear uses translated Mprime_s/(2*Atshell). Missing shell arms or nonpositive area leave unavailable values null; strength, warping and transverse-shear stresses are not inferred.

Static source equations with coupled sections, finite axial/shear stiffness, section and distributed-CG offsets, and rigid, pinned, roller and sprung joints; no stepped axes, body charts, airflow, motion, struts, engines or dynamics.
The averaged transform is generally not a rotation. Element local components use transform_average; the physical midpoint frame is for geometric display only.

Eq. 54 uses inverse averaged bending/torsion stiffness. EA, GK and offsets are averaged before applying Eqs. 18–19; ds is unloaded arc. These property/length interpretations are not proven historical executable conventions.
Element constitutive estimates use averaged shell properties. Endpoint traces and sensor strains use their one-sided section properties; exact ASWING output sampling remains unverified.
Mass and first moment follow the static endpoint-averaged gravity rule. Dynamic inertia and spin are unavailable for this operator.

Jangle uses natural cubic splines and the beam-1 inward endpoint/left interior structural-moment trace. ASWING spline/interior-joint trace parity and offset/interior hinge passivity are unverified; discontinuous angle jumps are unsupported. Equilibrium convergence does not establish static or dynamic stability.

output_scope.authoritative: Nodes, reactions, source constitutive element estimates, one-sided endpoint resultants/section recovery and sensor-anchor sections.
output_scope.element_coordinates: t locates the interval on plots; interval strains use the source averaged law. endpoint_traces contain actual sided point samples.
output_scope.strain_components: source_discrete_elements.axial_strain is reference-axis epsilon_s; elements.axial_strain_tension is Fs/EA. Closed-shell shear uses the translated elastic-axis torque.

joint_constraints.position: The joint pylon follows beam 1; the beam-2 attachment is free to rotate for type 1 and free to translate for type 2.
joint_constraints.moment: Type 3 uses the beam-1 inward endpoint or left interior structural moment, including distributed endpoint couples; it is not generally the free-end reaction couple.
joint_constraints.interpolation: Jangle retains the existing natural cubic interpolation, sided slope breaks and extrapolation. Historical spline-endpoint and interior-trace conventions remain unverified.
joint_constraints.rotations: Hinge winding uses version-2 equilibrium charts. Each source beam must still remain inside its nonsingular, uncut Euler chart.
joint_constraints.stability: A converged equilibrium does not establish stability or passivity of an offset or interior sprung joint.

limitations: Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Structural loads and strain use the inward endpoint and left trace at an interior sensor anchor, each in its actual one-sided section frame. Both adjacent traces remain available.
Shell strain/stress use the selected one-sided properties at the sensor anchor, not an adjacent element average. Exact historical ASWING trace choice at jumps remains unverified.
Static analysis has no airflow or time evolution; flow quantities remain unavailable.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.

equilibrium_state.units: Physical quantities in ASW input units; spatial rotation vectors in radians. Numerical solver scales are not stored.
limitations: This is a steady state. It contains no unsteady history or derivative state.
The source and mesh must match. Steady reuse corrects the full equilibrium; time launch validates the saved setup at zero local rates.
Local correction does not prove that a nonlinear branch is unique or that a fold has been followed.

Hinge angle_rad values retain the unwrapped static branch in radians. Matrices alone cannot authenticate their whole-turn count; time/checkpoint chart persistence is not provided by this static format.
Static source-discrete policy only; cannot initialize physical dynamics or a different structural operator.
